name: Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga - Article 5, après le § 1 - Am 333
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: Under no circumstances shall the actions, resources, assets, personnel or funding provided for under this Regulation be placed under military chain of command or be integrated into combat operations, collective defense or direct support to Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP) missions.
